# iApp Technologies LLP

> iApp Technologies LLP is a software development company founded in 2012, building mobile apps, web platforms, and AI-powered digital products for businesses worldwide.

## About

iApp Technologies LLP has been delivering technology solutions since 2012. The company specialises in mobile application development, web development, AI tools, and custom software for startups and enterprises.

## Services

- Mobile App Development (iOS & Android)
- Web Application Development
- AI-Powered Product Development
- Custom Software Solutions
- UI/UX Design
